our_interpretation: The central assertion concerns AI's contribution, not merely whether aggregate revenue or margins increased.
The Mag 7 means Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA and Tesla.
Read the spending threshold as cumulative realized capital expenditures since the November 2022 launch period, not announced future spending.
Read the ROIC clause as a decline in the group's latest quarterly observations, not necessarily a decline at every member.
Use the contextual AI period through Q3 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter potentially reported before the post.
